result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major missing image in the 'Popular right now' section and one minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: The first restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) has a broken/missing image, showing only a gray placeholder with a broken image icon.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL is valid and accessible. Implement a proper fallback image for cases where the primary image fails to load.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...'), cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Either allow the card to be wide enough to show the full name, use an ellipsis intentionally with a tooltip, or reduce the font size slightly to accommodate longer names within the card width.
